Class Character

java.lang.Object
fr.campus.d_and_d.characters.Character
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, Warrior, Wizard
public abstract class Character extends Object
Abstract class representing a character in the game. Subclasses must implement specific character types (e.g., Warrior, Wizard).

  • Constructor Details

    • Character

      public Character(String type, String name, int healthPoints, int attackPower, OffensiveEquipment offensiveEquipment, DefensiveEquipment defensiveEquipment)
      Creates a new character with specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      type - The type of the character (e.g., "Warrior" or "Wizard").
      name - The name of the character.
      healthPoints - The health points of the character.
      attackPower - The attack power of the character.
      offensiveEquipment - The offensive equipment of the character.
      defensiveEquipment - The defensive equipment of the character.
